info.title: Safe Line
info.description: Confidence-aware extraction engine for Israeli medical commitment forms

get.description:
Liveness and adapter readiness check.

Returns per-adapter status. API keys are never exposed —
only credential counts and circuit state.
Process-level aggregated counters since start-up. Counters only: no value, no PII.

The latest evaluation report (`eval/results/latest.json`), or `{"available": false}` when
no run has produced one. The report holds counts and rates, never a field value.

schema.title: Response Metrics Eval V1 Metrics Eval Get

post.description:
One document. 201 with the job, or 200 with `idempotent_replay` for a repeated key.

Raises UnsupportedMedia (415), TooLarge (413); answers 429 + Retry-After when the queue is
full. `cloud_consent` is the per-job consent of PLAN §8.5 (default: no).

Many documents (repeated `files` parts) or a ZIP, as one job. Same statuses as
`/documents`; the total size is bounded by `MAX_UPLOAD_MB`.

get.description: The job as the UI sees it. A purged job answers with status `purged` for a while, then 404.

delete.description: Purge the job's artefacts and data now. The job then answers `purged` for a while.

get.description: The rows only: the integration payload.

schema.title: Response Get Results V1 Jobs  Job Id  Results Get

get.description:
Server-sent progress: every event so far, then live ones, ending after `done`, on
disconnect or after the configured ceiling. A `: ping` comment keeps proxies from closing it.
The corrected page (`color`) or its thumbnail, as PNG. Never cached.

PNG of the region `box` (`y0,x0,y1,x1`, fractions of the page) plus `pad`, rendered on
demand from the corrected page. The long edge is capped at 1200 px.

patch.description:
Set a field to a typed value (`null` clears it) or to one of its candidates, recompute the
row level and append the change to the audit log. 422 for a value that breaks a hard rule,
404 for an unknown row or field, 409 on a confirmed or purged job.

post.description: Revert the last edit of the row. The log stays append-only: the undo is an entry too.

Mark the job reviewed. Rows keep `edited` where a person changed them and become
`confirmed` otherwise; a field accepted while still flagged is recorded in the audit log.
409 while the job is still running, and once it is confirmed.

get.description: Every review action on the job, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Get Audit V1 Jobs  Job Id  Audit Get

get.description:
The learning curve: one point per finished job, oldest first (`at`, `local_close_rate` and
the counters behind it). Empty when nothing has run or the store keeps no history.

schema.title: Response Metrics Learning V1 Metrics Learning Get

get.description:
The store exported as `learning_seed.json`: promoted boxes and shapes only, so a developer
can commit it (PLAN §7.4).

A new job over the source job's original pages, each degraded by each requested op.
422 for an unknown op, 501 when no augmenter is installed.

Return the closed list of known sender institutions.

Returns an empty list until Task 6 populates config/senders.json.
